content.title: BTS Is Coming to The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon for 2 Back-to-Back Episodes!
content.text: It's official: BTS is back, and they're taking over The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon in back-to-back episodes later this month!How to WatchWatch The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon on NBC weeknights at 11:35/10:35c and next day on Peacock.The supergroup will appear on The Tonight Show on March 25 and 26. And yes, that means RM, Jin, SUGA, j‑hope, Jimin, V, and Jung Kook will all not only be in-studio to chat with Jimmy Fallon about everything from joining back together to every detail about their new album. Best of all, the South Korean superstars will be taking the stage for two live performances.Their two-night event will come days after the release of their highly anticipated fifth studio album, Arirang, on March 20, with several Netflix streaming specials slated for the end of the month.Read on for more details below.RELATED: Demi Lovato's Earth-Shaking Vocals Won Jimmy Fallon's Musical Genre ChallengeThe return of BTS on The Tonight Show will air on March 25 and 26 at 11:35/10:35c on NBC. The episodes will be available to stream the following day on Peacock.As evident in this teaser sharing the news, nobody's more excited than Fallon himself.The visit marks "their first U.S. late night appearance as a full group since completing their mandatory military service. BTS will sit down for an in-studio interview and perform two songs – the interview and first song will air Wednesday, March 25 and the second song a day later," NBC revealed on March 18.RELATED: Why Jin Dedicated His New Album to Fans After His Military ServiceWhen did BTS last appear on The Tonight Show?All seven members of BTS completed their respective military service by June 2025, after taking a music hiatus to individually enlist in the military beginning in 2022. By law, 18-21 months of service are mandatory for all South Korean men.BTS last made a group appearance in July 2021's "BTS Takeover." That earned well over 120 million views across all digital platforms and featured performances of "Butter” and "Permission to Dance."RELATED: Jung Kook Talks Going Solo and Explains His Golden Album Title's MeaningSince then, several BTS members have visited Fallon solo.Which celebrities will appear with BTS on The Tonight Show on March 25 and 26?BTS won't be the only larger-than-life stars taking the stage and hanging out with Fallon.RELATED: Chris Pratt's Unconventional Ways of Getting Coins To Play Mario Arcade Games As a KidOn March 25, Ariana DeBose is slated to be a guest along with the K-pop kings, while The Super Mario Galaxy Movie's Chris Pratt and Charlie Day will stop by the studio for the March 26 episode.
